We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.

summary.takeaway: 提出“智能体管弦乐团”框架，用参数化量子电路实现音乐智能体，通过试错交互而非大数据模仿演化出各自不同的作曲“心态”。
summary.methods: 智能体以参数化量子电路实现，纠缠与叠加用于混合量子-经典循环中的决策空间探索；设计原子型（音高与节奏分别处理）与整体型（音高与时值为统一音符事件）两种架构，并以音乐化加权奖励塑造心态；演示在MIDI编码音乐上进行，并称在IBM量子硬件上验证。
summary.relevance: 采用强化学习式试错与多智能体交互进行音乐生成，与“强化学习”主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出与基线方法的定量比较；量子硬件实验结果的具体规模与统计细节未报告，结论主要依赖演示性描述。

papers.title: ViStep-RL: Stepwise Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Visual Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon visual agents must do more than inspect images: they must turn observations into evidence that remains usable as a task unfolds. Existing active-perception methods teach agents where and how to look, while a final-answer reward gives little structure for deciding which observations satisfy dependent subgoals or should be retained for later use. We present ViStep-RL (Visual Stepwise Reinforcement Learning), which models execution as a dependency-linked graph of evidence-bearing subgoals. A verifier tracks which subgoals are supported by valid evidence, and changes in graph potential provide a net-progress learning signal; an active memory protocol preserves evidence across turns and links retrieval to downstream use. On ViInteract, ViStep-RL reaches 60.0% strict completion with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, compared with 10.0% for the base model and 46.5% after supervised fine-tuning. Controlled studies show that incremental task-state rewards outperform cumulative rewards by 3.2 points, while active evidence writing improves strict completion by 7.75 points over automatic writing. Under a common interaction framework, the task-trained ViStep-RL policy achieves 59.5% answer accuracy, 24.0 points above the strongest of six general-purpose reference models. Held-out episodes confirm the gain at both Qwen scales, and gains extend to three external visual reasoning benchmarks.

summary.takeaway: 将长程视觉智能体的执行建模为依赖关联的证据子目标图，用图势能变化提供净进展的逐步强化学习信号，并配合主动记忆协议跨轮保存证据。
summary.methods: 提出ViStep-RL：验证器跟踪子目标是否被有效证据支持，以图势能变化作为奖励；主动记忆协议将证据检索与下游使用关联；在ViInteract上以Qwen2.5-VL-7B训练，并做受控消融与外部基准测试。
summary.relevance: 核心为逐步奖励设计与策略训练，属于“强化学习”主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出ViInteract及三个外部基准上的结果，未说明训练数据规模与计算成本；逐步奖励的具体形式与潜在额外标注需求未详述。

papers.title: VESPA: Verifiable Symbolic Policy Adaptation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) aims to prevent agents from taking actions that are dangerous or destructive to their environment. This is especially important for safety-critical domains, such as robotics or autonomous driving. Formal verification can be used to prove agent safety through safety constraints. However, in practice, many policies do violate safety constraints, and thus are verified to be unsafe. Since the goal is to obtain a safe policy, we would need to retrain a new policy from scratch and then verify it again until a candidate happens to pass. Both training and verification are usually not cheap, which makes this process inefficient. We introduce VESPA ($\textbf{VE}$rifiable $\textbf{S}$ymbolic $\textbf{P}$olicy $\textbf{A}$daptation), a framework for targeted fine-tuning of decision tree policies. We show that using counterexamples for policy adaptation can make existing unsafe policies safe, or at least make considerable progress towards safety. Targeted fine-tuning of the existing policy on those counterexamples enables it to learn how to avoid violating safety constraints. We thus use the result of a formal verification as a training signal for fine-tuning. On CartPole, VESPA raises the mean number of verified safe steps from 63.8 to at least 92.7, reaching after two iterations what the same loop without counterexamples reaches after ten. On MountainCarContinuous, VESPA turns an unsafe policy into a safe policy in 53 of 60 runs. We conclude that counterexamples from a verifier are an effective training signal, which can be utilized to systematically improve the safety of policies. Our implementation is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VESPA-Submission/

summary.takeaway: VESPA用形式验证器产生的反例作为训练信号，对决策树策略做定向微调，从而把不安全策略改造为更安全的策略，避免从零重训练。
summary.methods: 对决策树策略进行形式验证，将违反安全约束的反例用于定向微调；在CartPole与MountainCarContinuous上评估验证安全步数与转为安全的运行次数。
summary.relevance: 以验证反例驱动策略改进，属于安全强化学习与策略优化的交叉，契合“强化学习”主题。
summary.caveat: 方法面向决策树策略，能否推广到神经网络策略未在摘要中说明；实验仅限两个经典控制环境，真实安全关键场景的验证尚缺。

papers.title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
papers.abstract: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.

summary.takeaway: 受大脑清醒-睡眠周期启发，提出双阶段边缘持续学习平台Hypnos：日常低功耗推理与无梯度原型更新，充电时进行基于排练的梯度巩固。
summary.methods: 清醒阶段在RISC-V MCU系统级芯片上做推理与轻量无梯度原型更新；睡眠阶段在智能充电器上做排练式梯度更新；部署于ZCU104 FPGA、28nm工艺综合，在CORe50 NICv2-391协议上基准测试。
summary.relevance: 针对非平稳数据流的在线适应与灾难性遗忘缓解，属于“持续学习”主题。
summary.caveat: 精度与延迟数据来自特定硬件与CORe50协议，跨硬件与跨数据集的泛化性未在摘要中体现；双阶段依赖充电等外部条件，实际部署约束未讨论。

papers.title: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. Contested weights take a gradient-ascent step projected orthogonally to the retention gradient. The remaining capacity learns the incoming task by a privileged teacher via self-distillation. Deletion is served post hoc, and no retraining is required. Across both CL and MU jobs, LwU outperforms or matches the strongest baseline. Its real-world practicality has been demonstrated on the Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI) dataset we conducted. Additionally, in the image generation task and in removing dangerous content, it outperformed the closest baseline, as shown in Fig.1.

summary.takeaway: 提出LwU统一框架，在单个突触层面按“保留”“删除”两种评分对权重分区并施加不同更新规则，以同时服务持续学习与机器遗忘。
summary.methods: 对每个权重分别针对保留数据与删除数据打分，将网络划分为四个区域：仅保留权重冻结，仅删除权重清零并回收为自由容量，争议权重沿与保留梯度正交方向做梯度上升，其余容量通过特权教师自蒸馏学习新任务；删除事后完成，无需重训练。
summary.relevance: 同时处理持续学习中的知识保留与定向知识移除，直接对应“持续学习”主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数值指标，仅称优于或匹配最强基线；四区划分阈值与特权教师来源等关键实现细节未展开，实际可扩展性有待验证。

papers.title: UCLIR: Unsupervised Continual Learning using Independent Representations
papers.abstract: In continual learning, regularization-based methods aim to mimic neuroplasticity by updating network weights to learn new tasks while constraining changes to parameters that are important for previously learned tasks through penalty terms. However, as the number of tasks increases, preserving knowledge from earlier tasks becomes less effective. This is mainly because updates for new tasks are distributed across the entire network, where parameters are highly interdependent due to the dense connectivity between neurons. Inspired by the Exponential Distance Rule (EDR), which states that the number of neural connections decreases with increasing physical distance, learning is naturally locally correlated while inter-area updates remain less task-dependent. Motivated by this principle, in this paper we demonstrate that applying weight regularization to multiple small and independently learned complementary representations is more effective than regularizing a single large shared representation. By decomposing the input into independently learned components, learning new tasks induces only localized parameter updates within specific representation, which limit interference and improve knowledge retention across tasks. We employ independent autoencoders that learn different parts of the input independently through unsupervised regularization. At inference time, a linear classifier is used for evaluation. The experimental results on a sequence of tasks using 5-Splits MNIST, sequence of 5-datasets, 5-Splits CIFAR-10, 10-Splits Tiny ImageNet shows competitive results with supervised and replay-based methods. Code is available.

summary.takeaway: 提出UCLIR，将输入分解为多个独立学习的自编码器表示，对每个小表示分别做权重正则，使新任务只引起局部参数更新，从而减少干扰、提升旧任务保留。
summary.methods: 受指数距离规则启发，用独立自编码器以无监督正则分别学习输入的不同部分，推理时接线性分类器；在5-Splits MNIST、5-datasets序列、5-Splits CIFAR-10与10-Splits Tiny ImageNet上评估。
summary.relevance: 面向持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与正则化方法改进，属于“持续学习”主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称结果与监督式和回放式方法具有竞争力，未给出具体数值；任务序列长度有限，更长序列与更大规模输入下的表现未说明。

papers.title: Engineered post-transcriptional regulation of Scn10a by Pumilio ameliorates neuropathic pain in mice
papers.abstract: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA permeates biology, yet its contribution to sensory neuron physiology and pain remains unclear. The mammalian Pumilio proteins PUM1 and PUM2 (collectively referred to as PUM) are RNA-binding proteins that bind Pumilio response elements (PREs), typically situated in 3' untranslated regions. PUM recruits the CCR4-NOT complex to promote mRNA deadenylation and decay. Several mRNAs that encode voltage-gated sodium channels that regulate action potential generation in pain sensing neurons harbor PREs. Here, we explored whether PUM plays a role in pain signaling. PUM1 and PUM2 were enriched in TRPV1-positive dorsal root ganglion neurons, where PUM2 physically interacted with Scn9a, Scn10a, and Scn11a transcripts, which encode Nav1.7, Nav1.8, and Nav1.9, respectively. Depletion of PUM in sensory neurons produced mechanical hypersensitivity and enhanced inflammatory pain. These effects were reversed by blocking Nav1.8 but not Nav1.7, raising the possibility that repression of Scn10a by PUM can be harnessed using synthetic biology to diminish neuropathic pain. To this end, we generated a chimera comprising the RNA-binding domain of PUM2 and a repressive domain, which we dubbed "super-PUM". Expression of AAV-encoded super-PUM in sensory neurons reduced Nav1.8 abundance, diminished tetrodotoxin-resistant and suzetrigine-sensitive sodium currents, and prevented mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity following spared nerve injury. These results demonstrate that optimization of an endogenous post-transcriptional regulon provides a means to ameliorate neuropathic pain.

summary.takeaway: 发现PUM1/PUM2在TRPV1阳性背根神经节神经元中通过PRE结合Scn9a/Scn10a/Scn11a转录本，并设计“super-PUM”嵌合体抑制Scn10a，减轻小鼠神经病理性疼痛。
summary.methods: 在感觉神经元中敲低PUM并检测机械与炎症痛行为，用阻断Nav1.8/Nav1.7区分通路；构建PUM2 RNA结合域与抑制域融合的super-PUM，经AAV在感觉神经元表达，检测Nav1.8丰度、TTX抗性与suzetrigine敏感钠电流及 spared nerve injury 后的痛行为。
summary.relevance: 围绕PUM-PRE调控模块及其靶基因集合展开，属于“GRN / Regulon”主题的转录后调控子研究。
summary.caveat: 证据主要来自小鼠模型，人类疼痛中的保守性与治疗可行性未验证；AAV递送、长期抑制Scn10a的副作用及脱靶效应未在摘要中评估。

papers.title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
papers.abstract: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.

summary.takeaway: 提出CAR智能体框架，将AI研究构思分解为文献接地、迭代开发和显式概念算子（bisociation、analogy、exploration、elaboration），并记录可检查的变换轨迹与文献来源。
summary.methods: 从检索文献构建语义知识图谱，为构思智能体配备图检索工具与四种算子，算子调用需通过结构接受条件并记录；在40个LiveIdeaBench主题与两个执行基准上，用两种语言模型骨干评估，并做十条件消融。
summary.relevance: 结合大语言模型智能体与知识图谱检索进行科学构思，直接对应“大语言模型”与“知识图谱”主题。
summary.caveat: 作者自述方法新颖性相对Research Ideation Agent无显著差异，且消融中新颖性对比经多重比较校正后均不显著，因此显式算子是否带来一致质量收益尚未确立。

papers.title: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
papers.abstract: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Generative Montage 来描述语言模型智能体的“叙事过度拟合”失败：智能体将真实信息碎片用自生成关系拼接成误导性叙事，并把推断出的关系当作既定事实传播；同时提出 Grounded Monitor 运行时监控器以核查直接证据支持。
summary.methods: 基于叙事理解认知理论与蒙太奇电影理论设计生成式蒙太奇流程，让多个智能体把真实片段组织成误导叙事；在来自六个 Twitter 事件的 1,090 个谣言目标上评测十四个模型，并做片段干预与合成对照，区分信念影响与证据支持；最后用神经符号运行时监控器 Grounded Monitor 做概念验证。
summary.relevance: 该工作涉及语言模型智能体的信念形成与错误传播，以及基于证据的关系核查，与检索增强与对齐、图谱构建与表示（推断关系与证据支持）主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告总体接受率与 Grounded Monitor 的准确率提升区间，未给出统计显著性、样本划分细节或监控器的计算开销；Grounded Monitor 为概念验证，泛化性需进一步验证。
